The '''Otoh Gunga Transit Authority''' was an organization created by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of the underwater city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Lob Dizz]] was noted for being a respected [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who had worked for both the Otoh Gunga Transit Authority and the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="Deep Spoilers" />
